text: The end-semester examinations for Second Year Computer Engineering begin on 12 November 2026. Download hall tickets from the student portal before 8 November and report to the examination hall by 9:00 AM.
Practical examinations for the third-year science students will be held from 3 to 6 December 2026 in the department laboratories. Bring your journal and college identity card.
The revised university examination timetable is available on the college website. The B.Com paper scheduled for 18 November 2026 will now take place on 20 November 2026.
Students appearing for the supplementary examination must submit the examination form to the office by 25 October 2026 and pay the prescribed examination fee.
The internal assessment test for first-year students is scheduled for 28 October 2026 in the regular classrooms. Contact your class coordinator for the subject-wise schedule.
Eligible students may apply for the state merit scholarship for the 2026-27 academic year. Submit the online application and income certificate by 30 November 2026.
The college scholarship committee invites applications from students with financial need. Collect the form from the student welfare office and submit it with supporting documents by 15 October 2026.
Renewal applications for the national scholarship portal are open. Upload your latest marksheet and bank details before 10 November 2026 to avoid interruption of payment.
Students who received the minority scholarship last year must verify their profile with the scholarship section by 22 October 2026. Bring original documents for verification.
A private foundation is offering five scholarships to engineering students with strong academic records. Interested applicants should email their statement of purpose by 5 December 2026.
The campus placement registration portal is open for final-year students. Complete your profile and upload your resume by 24 October 2026 to participate in company recruitment drives.
Aptitude training for eligible engineering candidates will begin on 2 November 2026 in Seminar Hall B. Register with the training and placement cell by 27 October.
BrightTech Solutions will conduct a pre-placement talk on 19 October 2026 at 11:00 AM in the auditorium. Shortlisted students must attend with their college identity card.
Students selected for the campus interview with Northstar Systems should report to the placement office at 8:30 AM on 29 October 2026. Business formal dress is required.
The placement cell is collecting updated resumes from graduating students. Email your PDF resume and preferred job role to the placement coordinator by 1 November 2026.
The annual cultural festival Udaan will take place on 14 and 15 December 2026 on the main campus. Students can register for music and dance events at the student council desk.
The Department of Physics is hosting a national seminar on renewable energy on 6 November 2026 in the central auditorium. Faculty and students may register by 1 November.
The student council will hold an inter-college debate competition in Room 204 on 12 November 2026. Teams of two should submit their names to the council by 5 November.
Join the campus tree-planting drive at the east gate on 24 October 2026 at 7:30 AM. Volunteers should bring a reusable water bottle and register with the environmental club.
The college is organizing a coding hackathon called CodeSprint on 21 November 2026 in the innovation lab. Form a team of up to four students and register online.
Payment of the second-semester tuition fee is due by 31 October 2026. Pay through the student portal or visit the accounts office during working hours.
Students with outstanding library dues must clear their balance before collecting the examination hall ticket. Contact the library counter for the amount payable.
The last date to pay the laboratory fee for the current term is 26 October 2026. Late payments may attract an additional charge under college rules.
Students who have not paid the transport fee should submit payment to the accounts section by 20 October 2026. Include your student registration number with the receipt.
The college has published the fee schedule for the 2026-27 academic year. Students may request an installment plan from the accounts office before 5 November 2026.
The library will begin extended study hours from 1 November 2026. It will remain open until 8:00 PM on weekdays during the semester.
First-year students must attend the laboratory safety orientation on 23 October 2026 in the chemistry department. Attendance will be recorded by the department.
The Department of Computer Science has published the academic calendar for the winter term. Download the course schedule from the department notice board.
Students interested in the research project elective should meet their faculty mentor by 30 October 2026 to discuss project topics and group preferences.
The college will conduct a workshop on academic writing for postgraduate students on 7 November 2026 in the language lab. Seats are limited and registration is required.
The college will remain closed on 20 October 2026 on account of the regional festival. Classes and administrative offices will resume on 21 October.
A public holiday has been declared for 1 November 2026. All lectures, examinations, and office services scheduled for that day are postponed.
The campus will be closed from 24 to 26 December 2026 for the winter break. Hostel dining services will follow a separate schedule.
There will be no classes on 14 November 2026 due to a local civic holiday. The revised lecture schedule will be shared by each department.
The state government has announced a holiday on 6 December 2026. The college library and administrative offices will remain closed for the day.
All students must update their emergency contact details in the student portal by 28 October 2026. Contact the help desk if you cannot access your account.
The college identity card distribution counter will operate in the main office from 10:00 AM to 3:00 PM on weekdays. Bring your admission receipt when collecting the card.
The lost-and-found desk has received several water bottles and notebooks. Students may check with the security office near the main gate during office hours.
Students are requested to keep corridors clear and use the designated bicycle parking area. The campus administration thanks everyone for their cooperation.
The college bus route for the northern suburbs has been revised. View the updated route list on the transport notice board or contact the transport office for assistance.
